text: The system features a 10-minute analytic cadence, expansion from 75 to 223 monitoring points, integration with private navigation apps for real-time rerouting, automatic multi-agency alerting, and location-specific public messages. It prioritizes high-risk riverine sites and aims to prevent tragedies like the 2023 Osong underpass flooding.

metadata.solution_name: Ministry of Environment AI-based Flood Forecasting and Early Warning System
